Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: He
Message:
feat(benchmark): real-model evaluation on Ark deepseek-v4-flash - 6/6 runs verified

All three strategies x two tasks ran end to end on a real provider
(OpenAI-compatible endpoint, key injected via DEEPSEEK_API_KEY env only,
never stored). Every run completed and passed the independent
verification check; fixtures were reset to the same committed state
before each run.

Evidence committed under docs/architecture/v2/benchmark/real/:
per-run JSON records, merged records/summary, and the complete task +
worker event streams (2.9 MB) for full traceability.

Findings recorded honestly in FINAL-ACCEPTANCE-REPORT 4b:
- the complexity assessor classified both tasks as simple -> direct mode
  (by design); real-model plan/multi planning needs a complex task set
- n=2 simple tasks support no strategy-superiority claim; multi was in
  fact slower (415s avg vs planner 78s)
- single (v1 session path) hit 3 approval waits; supervised paths get
  fail-closed policy denies instead - different semantics, both safe
- high-quality real trace: the model wrote a scratch verifier, was
  denied run_command twice (fail-closed), self-deleted the scratch via
  apply_patch, verified a clean tree, completed with evidence claims

Also: benchmark_matrix.py metric aggregation now folds workers attached
to the root itself (direct mode); benchmark fixtures (demo, bench-calc
with an intentional add() bug) committed as plain files - init them as
repos before real multi runs (see report section 7); report/AGENT.md/
REMEDIATION-REPORT updated accordingly.
